notes.title: Turbo Golf Racing 1.0 Update! 🥳
notes.content:
Turbo Golf Racing has officially launched out of early access, so we're having a party... and you're all invited! 🥳🎉

What's new:
🎂 Season 4: Launch Party is now live, with 40 rewards to obtain
🏌️ 8 Player Golf, a new game mode is available to play
⛳ 10 new levels across the 5 existing biomes!
🌍 Urban, Wild and Industrial have been revamped
🌙 Night versions are available on some new and old levels
🔧 Garage Loadouts have been added, you can save cosmetic set-ups
🔩 Smash and Dash, a new passive core
🐙 32 new shop items, including the community designed Octoball, and more expensive items
🔄 Timed Events will now cycle each month, and some old events have been improved with new rewards
📊 Leaderboards have been reset to mark the start of a new season

Turbo Golf Racing is also now Steam Deck certified! 🏅

Check out the full patch notes:

notes.title: New Game Mode! ⛳
notes.content:
⛳ GOLF MODE ⛳
In a battle of precision and skill, compete head-to head to putt your ball in the fewest shots. Utilise the new aerial camera to survey your surroundings and make every shot count. Plus, hit your ball further than before with the new power dash mechanic! 🦾

We've added a handy tutorial to help you get a feel for it before taking on an opponent in casual or custom games.

⚓ GRAPPLE NERF ⚓
We listened to the issues Grapple Hook has caused, requiring little skill but providing huge benefits. The ball is no longer frozen in place when Grapple Hook is active. This change has reduced the predictability of grapple, increasing the skill level required for useful shots.

🚀 NEW ADVENTURES 🚀
There’s 2 new adventures to complete: Golfing and Progression! Golfing features missions exclusive to the new game mode. Progression provides players with long term goals to work towards!

A full list of changes can be found below:

notes.title: Custom Games Are Here!
notes.content:
Hey Racers,

After much anticipation, Custom Games have arrived! So get your engines revving, tyres pumping and games updating... This is what's in store:

🔧 Custom Games 🔧
Host games up to 8 players, in private or public custom games! Choose up to 12 levels, with specific pick ups, cores and bot settings! Did I mention you can choose to spectate too? 👀

🏆 Ranked Improvements 🏆
No more losing points for winning! We've reverted back to New Skill, allowing you to rise the ranks faster! Ranked players will face off in 5 levels instead of 3, and to prevent foul play, homing missiles will no longer appear in ranked. Plus we've fixed that pesky bug causing you to lose rank points when you were clearly the best player. 🕷️

❄️ Frost Beam ❄️
Ever wanted to freeze your opponents? Well now you can, with this new pick up! Shoot a Frost Beam in front of you causing opponents to skid across the tracks and lose control! 🧊

🚀 Air Strike 🚀
Prepare for mayhem with our new Air Strike pick up! Fire an aerial strike at an opponent, homing in on them, creating an explosion area of effect as it hits the ground! 💥

🪝 Grapple Hook 🪝
There's a new core! Grapple Hook latches your car onto your ball, slowing your ball as your car propels towards it! 🪢

🦈 Shark Event 🦈
We've got some new missions for you to sink your teeth into... The Shark Event (Part 1) is now live! You have a few weeks to collect the first half of this jawesome set of items! 🌊

🏪 Shop and Garage Updates 🏪
You can now purchase random chests in the shop, featuring past rewards from seasons 1 and 2! The garage also displays how many items you have left to collect! Most importantly, car bodies are back in the shop and available to purchase! 🪙

⛳ New Levels ⛳
There are 4 new space levels to try out! But better than that, the community design, Big L, has been added! Be sure to join our discord and enter our community competitions to have your designs added to the game! 🖌️ 

Check out our full patch notes!

New Features:

 10 new space levels with a focus on twisted gravity!
 40 rewards to obtain in Season 3!
 New casual play queue.
 Eight new avatars will be awarded for Season 2 rating placement.
 New Trail Blazer core - increase speed on boost pads.

Updated Features:

 All leaderboards have been reset, including time trial, wins and ranking. Data from season 1 and 2 can be accessed via Discord.

 Win counter has been updated to count ranked wins.
 Leaderboard prerequisite has been removed.

> Hyper Glider only increases speed whilst boost is not depleted.
> Hot Head speed has increased.
> Stomp has reduced boost duration and no longer replenishes boost.

notes.title: Turbo Golf Racing Mid-Season Update OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey there racers,
If you’ve been following our social channels or Discord then you may have seen the teases in the past few days for today’s update. Well, the Turbo Golf Racing Mid-Season Update is OUT NOW and with it comes a whole load of new content, improvements, as well as some important community-requested changes. So, what’s in the new update?

New and Improved Party System
One of the most requested community features is now in the game – Cross-platform parties. You and your friends can now party-up and play together regardless of platform. In addition to this you can now add ‘TGR Friends’ using a friend code from any platform. Players can now see other players vehicles in the lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/76640c88084587f573e8ab2f2173860f082cd003.png

Leaderboards
Another much-requested feature from the community was the addition of Leaderboards to the game.  We have added both multiplayer and singleplayer leaderboards to the Time Trial tab in-game (previously named Solo). Multiplayer leaderboards show times that have been recorded in online games and are therefore verified times. Time Trial leaderboards are recorded by players offline and while these times are not verified, they will be moderated. We’ve also added a filter option; allowing you to switch between global leaderboards and those of your friends.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/c28f1bc6eee564312b1d683748dced74d0cb13b1.png

Known Issue: We are aware of a bug which may prevent a player's best singleplayer time from updating correctly. We have addressed the problem and a fix will be released shortly.

6 New Levels
In this update we’ve added 6 new levels for you to enjoy. These are:

 Rough Hill
 Hurricane Lane
 Three peaks
 Endurance
 Par 5
 Avalanche

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/4f4f7e0bf307227a6bb34597276c96519982b30e.png

New Car and Ball (Ratoon and Engine)
In addition to the 6 new levels, stand out from the crowd with the new post-apocalyptic Ratoon vehicle and Engine ball. You’d be madder than Mad Max if you miss these awesome new additions. Check out the video of the sweet new ride below.

[previewyoutube=dobM9eKwwxo;full][/previewyoutube]

New Power Cores
For the Mid-Season update we’ve added two new Power Cores and tweaked some existing ones to fix balance and gameplay issues.

 Ice Lock (Active) – Freeze your ball in its current position for a short while with Ice Lock
 Big Shot (Passive) – Increase your ball hit power with the Big Shot Power Core

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/5d20ffe5db32993860e1a6867e1be05bb4fa9a06.png
Power Core Changes

 Hot Head has been buffed
 Curve Ball strength has been reduced
 Quick Flip now awards shield and boost for side flip. Side flip has been fixed at high speed

New Cosmetics and Community Decals
As with all existing vehicles, the Ratoon car parts can be mixed and matched with other car parts to make a truly unique combination. These new cosmetic parts are:

 Ratoon car body
 Glider spoiler
 Vector wheels
 Claws wheels
 Shutter Club shield


The community is what makes this game, and so we’re always looking to add community-created content into Turbo Golf Racing. In this update we’ve added *4 community-created decal sets as well as some additional ones from us.

 Diamond
 Cross
 Side Fade
 Side Fade Extra
 Catfish*
 Burn*
 Impact*
 Floral*

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/871ddd05c8c203378775f4ad1c5e6e2a3a85ad3a.png
In addition to the cool decals, we’ve added a new ‘Digital’ finish, Crosshair Avatar, and the following Booster styles:

 Volcano
 Earth
 Storm

Changes to Quick Chat
The following changes have been made to the in-game quick chat system:
Added:

 Good Luck
 Good Game
 Thanks
 Well Played
 Sorry!

Removed:

 GG
 GLHF
 Party Face

General Gameplay Improvements
We’ve made the following changes and improvements to Turbo Golf Racing; these have been split into gameplay, matchmaking, and game loop.

Gameplay:

 Balanced the steering curve to be more consistent with speed increases
 Added steering sensitivity slider
 Halved the default aim assist
 Small adjustments to the default camera angle
 The ball prediction line is now off by default
 Changed boost visuals (screen warp and boost lines. Added chromatic aberration)
 Reduced the sensitivity of handbrake
 Tightened the ‘dash camera’
 Networking improvements: Improved the camera behaviour where the players simulation falls behind the server

Matchmaking:

 Players with less than 5 games played will have a limited map selection
 Games with an average ELO of 1500 or more will not get given the shortest maps
 Game loop:
 The camera will now swap to spectator camera after scoring quicker
 There is now a minimum time before the DNF timer begins counting, based on the level’s 3 star time
 You can now score after the timer finishes to prevent a DNF if your last touch of the ball was prior to the timer hitting zero
 Pressing Esc in the lobby will now bring up the exit game menu
 The game won’t wait for AFK players during the countdown
 Various level fixes and balances

Finally, we want to take a minute to thank you for your continued patience, support, and also for your feedback; all of which is incredibly important to us. 

See you on the starting line!
Team Hugecalf

notes.title: Turbo Golf Racing - Level Design Competition
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/a318dbd26b8672a04f4429fe644ddaad479be2b1.png

Hey there racers,
We’re continually blown away by your submissions and suggestions for new content for the game; you’re an incredibly creative community and we love that!

So for our latest community-design competition we thought we’d let you design a level!  The winning design will be decided on by team Hugecalf 🐮, we will then make it and put it into the game.


All you need to do is come up with your dream level and submit it via the dedicated Competitions channel on the official Turbo Golf Racing Discord before midnight on September 15th (BST) . You could submit a hand-drawn course on a napkin or a fully-rendered 3D model of your course – what you submit is entirely up to you.

Go solo or as a group:
If you want to collaborate on a level design with friends, you can do so – we’ll credit you as a whole so come up with a witty collective name for inclusion in the game. If you’d prefer to design a level on your own, that’s A-OK with us.

Things to think about when designing your level:
Aim to keep your designs within the existing framework that we use. This will maximise the chances of your level being picked and put into the game! Here are a few pointers that may assist you in your level creation.

The Hook: 

 What makes your level stand out?
 What makes it memorable?

Level Shape:

 What's the overall level shape?
 Level length, how long will it take for players to complete?
 How does the height change through the level?
 Is it easy/hard for players to go out of bounds and how high are the barriers in each area?

How will players interact with your level?
When creating your level, please consider the placement of these things:

 Boost pads
 Boost rings
 Pickups
 Trees
 Bunkers
 Rough

Theme and Environment:

 What theme is the level in... Urban / Wild / Industrial ?
 What colour scheme... blue / purple / red ?

Have fun creating your levels, we are very much looking forward to seeing all of your submissions!

Now some important rules and stuff.

The Rules:

 Competition Brief: Design a level for inclusion in a future Turbo Golf Racing update
 Competition start date: September 1st 2022.
 Competition end date: 23:59 PM, September 15th 2022.
 Submission process: Entrants must submit their entry via the official Turbo Golf Racing Discord in the appropriate competition channels. Any entries submitted outside of this will not be considered.
 By entering the competition, you agree that your entry and your name can be used in promotional activity such as social media posts.
 Please note that the winning design may be altered at our discretion. 

The Prize:
One winning submission will be added to a future Turbo Golf Racing update and will be made available to play for an undetermined period.

Passive Power Cores:
Passive Power Cores are ‘always on’ and you don’t need to worry about activating them mid-race. You can equip up to two Passive Cores in the available Power Core Sockets (one in each).

notes.title: An Introduction to Power Cores Part 1
notes.content:
What’s up racers?

We can’t believe that Turbo Golf Racing is literally less than a week away from launching! The excitement here at Hugecalf is at maximum overdrive and we can’t wait to join you in-game on August 4th.

Ahead of next week’s launch, we wanted to give you a brief overview of the game’s Power Core system. It’s a key component to getting a competitive edge on your opponents on the fairway, as this allows you to customise your vehicle to suit your playstyle.

Types of Power Core:
There are two types of Power Core: Passive and Active. As the name suggests, Passive Cores are ‘always on’ and you don’t need to worry about activating them mid-race. Active Cores on the other hand need to be triggered during a race with a simple button press, and have a short cooldown before they can be used again. 

Power Core Sockets:
Each vehicle is equipped with two Power Core Sockets that give players the freedom to mix-and-match Power Cores to suit their playstyle. The Power Socket permits the use of either Passive or Active Power Cores, while the Passive Socket will only accept Passive Power Cores. 

Unlocking Power Cores:
Power Cores are unlocked by completing various challenges in-game. For example, to unlock the Hot Head Power Core, you must complete five online matches.

Active Power Cores:
Today, we’re going to cover just the three Active Power Cores and we’ll have a separate post tomorrow looking at the Passive Power Cores.

Active Cores

[table]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/f9c3d8a953887ce086601fa44f022ef1d51baace.png[/td]
        [td]Magnet
Magnetises the ball towards your car – The perfect Power Core for when you accidently overshoot the hole[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/b88cc1096fc93ec079d3610294fac8d908851f60.png[/td]
        [td]Quick Flip
Performs a quick flip or roll to gain speed – Use this Power Core to avoid a rocket attack or to get a bit of a speed boost
[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/05464c3db3c0ab9782e263a5edc85808a5ef4eaa.png[/td]
        [td]Shock
Creates a short-range shockwave which pushes your ball away from your car – Need to clear the rough in a hurry? This is the Power Core for you![/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Experimenting with different combinations of Power Cores is an important gameplay tactic to ensure you have the advantage on the course. With the right combination, you’ll be able to play to your strengths as a racer and sprint towards the finish flag.

More Power Cores will be added to Turbo Golf Racing in the future as free content updates, alongside new Seasons, cosmetic items, and even full courses.

In Sunday's post we’ll be looking at the Passive Power Cores.

See you on the starting line,
Team Hugecalf
